cues.en: Instructor: This section of the course is quite a bit different from all the other sections of this course.
cues.zh: 講師：課程這一節與其他所有章節都相當不同。

cues.en: Here, there isn't a specific narrow topic that I'm going to teach you about.
cues.zh: 這裡沒有一個我要教你的特定狹窄主題。

cues.en: Instead, we are going to apply a bunch of analyses and data processing and visualization strategies that you've already learned about, to a real dataset.
cues.zh: 我們要把已經學過的各種分析、資料處理與視覺化策略，應用到真實資料集。

cues.en: So the purpose of this section is to walk through an example of obtaining a dataset from a freely available dataset online, I'll tell you about that in a moment,
cues.zh: 因此，這一節的目的是示範一個例子：從網路上免費提供的資料集取得資料，稍後我會介紹，

cues.en: and then I'm going to clean the data, visualize the data, and run some analyses.
cues.zh: 接著清理資料、視覺化資料，再執行一些分析。

cues.en: Again, these are all methods that you've already learned about.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這些都是你已經學過的方法。

cues.en: So the focus of this section is the thought process that I went through to work with these data.
cues.zh: 因此，本節重點是我處理這些資料時的思考過程。

cues.en: So you don't need to learn things, you don't need to take notes if you don't want to, you can go through the code along with me, that's great.
cues.zh: 你不需要學新東西，不想做筆記也沒關係；可以跟著我操作程式，那很好。

cues.en: But you can also just sit back, relax and watch, and get inspired to see how I work through these data sets.
cues.zh: 也可以輕鬆坐著觀看，看看我如何處理這些資料集，從中取得靈感。

cues.en: The video organization of this section is also a little bit different because typically I would have MATLAB and Python in the same video,
cues.zh: 這一節的影片安排也有些不同，因為通常 MATLAB 與 Python 會放在同一部影片中，

cues.en: but I decided here to have a better flow.
cues.zh: 但這裡為了讓流程更順暢，

cues.en: I'm gonna have all of the MATLAB videos first.
cues.zh: 我決定先放所有 MATLAB 影片。

cues.en: There's gonna be several MATLAB videos that are exclusively MATLAB and several Python videos that are exclusively Python.
cues.zh: 會有幾部完全使用 MATLAB 的影片，以及幾部完全使用 Python 的影片。

cues.en: So if you're just following along in Python, you can skip the MATLAB videos.
cues.zh: 因此，如果你只跟著 Python 做，可以跳過 MATLAB 影片。

cues.en: If you're just following along in MATLAB, you can skip all of the Python videos.
cues.zh: 如果你只跟著 MATLAB 做，也可以跳過所有 Python 影片。

cues.en: Okay, so let me now tell you a little bit about the dataset.
cues.zh: 現在簡單介紹一下資料集。

cues.en: So I just searched around on the internet a little bit for some interesting dataset to work through.
cues.zh: 我在網路上搜尋了一下，尋找有趣的資料集來操作。

cues.en: I wanted a freely available dataset that was real, so not made up data, which, I often use simulated data.
cues.zh: 我想要一個免費提供的真實資料集，而不是編造的資料；我經常使用模擬資料，

cues.en: But in this case, I wanted to use a real, genuine data set, and I came across this data set on marriages
cues.zh: 但這次想使用真正的資料集，而我找到了這個關於婚姻

cues.en: and divorce rates across the US over time.
cues.zh: 與離婚率隨時間在美國各地變化的資料集。

cues.en: So these data are freely available from the CDC website.
cues.zh: 這些資料可以在 CDC 網站免費取得。

cues.en: CDC is the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.
cues.zh: CDC 是美國疾病管制與預防中心。

cues.en: So if you browse around on this website, you'll find that there is this link you'll find.
cues.zh: 如果瀏覽這個網站，你會找到這裡的連結，

cues.en: These two links in particular, so this is marriage rates and divorce rates by state, by US state for 1990, 1995, and all of the years.
cues.zh: 特別是這兩個連結：按州，也就是美國各州，列出的結婚率與離婚率，包含 1990、1995，以及其他各年。

cues.en: So we don't have every year in between 1990 and 1999.
cues.zh: 1990 到 1999 年之間，並不是每年都有資料。

cues.en: So we get these two years, and then we have every year from 99 up until 2019.
cues.zh: 所以先有這兩年，接著從 1999 年到 2019 年，每年都有。

cues.en: So let me show you what this data set looks like.
cues.zh: 讓我展示這個資料集的樣子。

cues.en: Here we have, you can get PDF or XLS.
cues.zh: 這裡可以選擇 PDF 或 XLS。

cues.en: This is the Excel file version.
cues.zh: 這是 Excel 檔案版本。

cues.en: This is the marriage rates.
cues.zh: 這是結婚率。

cues.en: So here we have this data table, and we have years over here.
cues.zh: 這裡是資料表，這邊是年份。

cues.en: It's going backwards, so it goes from 2019 over, and then we have all of the 50 states in the rows.
cues.zh: 順序是倒過來的，從 2019 年往前，而每一列是 50 個州之一。

cues.en: And these numbers here, the numbers for each state and each year correspond to the counts of marriages per 1000 population residing in the area.
cues.zh: 這些數字，也就是每個州、每個年份的數字，對應當地每 1,000 名居民的結婚件數。

cues.en: So that means that in 2019 in Alabama, there were 6.7 registered marriages in the state
cues.zh: 這表示，2019 年在阿拉巴馬州，每 1,000 名阿拉巴馬州居民，

cues.en: of Alabama for every 1000 residents of Alabama.
cues.zh: 就有 6.7 件在阿拉巴馬州登記的婚姻。

cues.en: Now, you can also see that there's a couple of missing data values.
cues.zh: 你也可以看到，有幾筆遺失值。

cues.en: So for example, in Georgia in 2014, I don't know why, but there's, presumably, people got married in Georgia in 2014.
cues.zh: 例如喬治亞州 2014 年，我不知道原因；那一年喬治亞州應該還是有人結婚，

cues.en: So I don't know why these data are missing, but you can see that there are just a couple of missing data values around here.
cues.zh: 所以我不知道為什麼資料遺失，但你可以看到，這裡就是有幾個遺失值。

cues.en: So we're gonna have to figure out a way to deal with that in the code.
cues.zh: 因此，必須想個方法在程式中處理。

cues.en: All right, so the next several videos are going to be me importing the data, cleaning the data including this stuff, also the divorce rate data.
cues.zh: 接下來幾部影片，會示範我匯入資料、清理資料，包含這些資料，也包含離婚率資料。

cues.en: This is just the marriage rate data.
cues.zh: 這裡只是結婚率資料。

cues.en: But the divorce rate data has a similar file structure.
cues.zh: 但離婚率資料的檔案結構也類似。

cues.en: And then we'll move to some data visualization so we can understand the data better.
cues.zh: 接著會進行一些資料視覺化，幫助更了解資料。

cues.en: And then finally, we'll do some inferential statistics, we'll run some correlation analyses and some regressions and T tests to see how these marriage
cues.zh: 最後，做一些推論統計，執行相關分析、迴歸與 t 檢定，看看這些結婚率

cues.en: and divorce rates are changing over time and relative to each other.
cues.zh: 與離婚率如何隨時間變化，以及彼此的關係。
